mapper.select: SELECT M.NO , M.NAME , M.TEL , M.EMAIL , D.NAME AS DEPART_NAME , P.NAME AS POSITION_NAME , M.WORK_STATUS_NO , W.STATUS AS WORK_STATUS_NAME FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON M.DEPART_NO = D.NO LEFT JOIN POSITION P ON M.POSITION_NO = P.NO LEFT JOIN WORK_STATUS W ON M.WORK_STATUS_NO = W.NO WHERE M.DEL_YN = 'N' AND M.COMPANY_NO = #{companyNo} ORDER BY M.DEPART_NO, M.POSITION_NO DESC, M.NAME
